messages:
maria: heads up — local starterkit onboarding trips when JSON mode + fncall used together. schema validator errors with trailing NULs. error: "Unexpected token \u0000 in JSON at position 512"

jon: which sdk/lang and sample app? paste the failing payload if you can

maria: node starter-kit, @redwood/sdk v0.18.3. repro: `npm run sample:local` -> /generate -> crash. minimal payload that fails: ```json
{"tool_call": {"name":"upsert_user", "args": "{\"id\":\"u123\"}\u0000\n"}}```

alex: oh yeah we've seen this. parsePad was introduced to handle streaming frames but it's being applied to non-stream responses in node helper. python only strips in streaming path. parity gap.

jon: also noticed retry/auth interaction: mid-request token refresh causes a retry that re-serializes the body and the runtime's pad handler then appends NULs again -> double-encoded tool args.

maria: that maps to 3 support tickets this week complaining about malformed tool args during onboarding.

sam: Support confirms short-lived tokens + SSO customers impacted. we need a hotfix ASAP.

ci-bot: Build #5421 failed: tests/sdk-jsonmode-toolcall -> parsing.test.ts:45

jon: propose fix: 1) make parsePad a no-op unless stream flag true; 2) ensure retry path preserves raw body (do not re-encode); 3) add unit tests for trailing NULs and double-encode cases. i'll open a PR in ~1h.

maria: add a short note in the sample-app quickstart about the temporary workaround for new users hitting this.

jon: adding a `compact_json` env option to sample-app so devs can avoid the helper during local runs. also gating parsePad via `REDWOOD_PARSE_PAD` env var for Dedicated/Private envs.

alex: sg. we'll default to off for new installs. for existing customers we expose env so they can opt-in.

sam: i'll draft a support KB and templated reply: suggest `export REDWOOD_PARSE_PAD=off` or pin to `@redwood/sdk@0.18.2` as a workaround.

ci-bot: PR #1147 created by jon: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/1147 (tests failing currently)

jon: pushed fixes for parity + retry double-encode, added tests for node/python parity. pinging @alex for a quick review.

alex: small nits, tests look solid. merge after CI green.

ci-bot: Build #5424 green. Merge pipeline passed.

maria: verified onboarding locally with patch — JSON mode + fncall now parse cleanly and schema validation passes. thanks team.

sam: support KB updated, tickets have templated replies queued.

ci-bot: PR #1147 merged by jon at 2723456821
